scope: Renderer compatibility, bounded visual batching, and graphics-device-loss handling. This is not a full campaign, physical-phone or sustained thermal benchmark.

comparison.fixture: Same procedural title scene; 1440×900 DPR 1; High; 28 asteroids and 1 player; five deterministic 1/60-second presentation updates; no simulation movement. The final measured render was scheduled in requestAnimationFrame.

webgl2.adapter: ANGLE / Mesa D3D12 / NVIDIA RTX4070SUPER;headed private Xvfb

webgpu.adapter: Google SwiftShader software Vulkan;headed private Xvfb

comparison.interpretation: 211→181 draw calls (-14.2%) on both backends. Two instanced palette batches preserve the individual transforms and shapes. Submitted triangles rise39546→40506 (+2.4%) because inexpensive20-face asteroids are no longer individually frustum-culled. Tracked GPU bytes fall slightly. No FPS-speedup claim: timing on the shared host varied with concurrent work.

mining.fixture: Renderer-only synthetic primary damage100, automatic aim at one existing asteroid; no rules-model reward/energy claims.

collisions.test: tests/asteroid-field.test.js / batched rocks keep independent Rapier collisions and mining removal
assertions: Player transfers momentum to the struck asteroid and slows down.
An untouched asteroid keeps its independent collider and position.
Mining removes only the struck collider and its visual instance; the other remains.

deviceLoss.trigger: WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext() in the actual initialized renderer
deviceLoss.contract: createScene options.onDeviceLost({api,message,reason}) runs once after Three marks the backend lost. update() then returns no events and performs no physics/rendering. getTelemetry().backendReady=false and deviceLost contains the report. dispose() suppresses callbacks caused by intentional destruction. The UI must pause rules-model time, save, and provide recovery.

rejectedOptimization: Disabling presentation MSAA was not retained: the original actual WebGL canvas already had antialias=false through Three’s output handling. Scene-pass4×MSAA remains unchanged.
remainingLimits: Firefox and WebKit integration belong to the parent compatibility matrix.
No physical-phone or hardware-WebGPU performance measurement.
Screenshots and raw probes are local .cache artifacts; their hashes identify the inspected evidence.
